story_info.title: Oliver Fox and the Lost Shiny Pebble
story_info.subtitle: A lesson in listening carefully
story_info.moral: Good friends listen carefully to each other.

main_character.name: Oliver Fox
main_character.appearance: Oliver is a slim young fox with bright orange-red fur, a fluffy white-tipped tail, and perky triangular ears. He has clever amber eyes and a playful, confident grin.

supporting_characters.name: Pip Sparrow
supporting_characters.appearance: A small brown sparrow with a fluffy chest and tiny yellow beak.
supporting_characters.role: lost her favourite shiny pebble and needs help finding it

slides.title: Oliver in Blossom Meadow
slides.text: One sunny morning, Oliver Fox skipped through Blossom Meadow. Pink, yellow, and blue flowers grew everywhere. Oliver loved to smell them. He felt happy. He saw his friend, Pip Sparrow, on a branch. Pip looked very sad. Her little head was down low. Oliver stopped to say hello.
slides.speaker_notes: Oliver Fox sees his friend Pip Sparrow looking sad in Blossom Meadow.

slides.title: Pip is Upset
slides.text: 'Hello, Pip! Why are you so sad?' Oliver asked softly. Pip chirped quickly. 'Oh dear! Oh no! It’s gone! My favourite, shiny, round…' Pip flapped her wings fast. Oliver could not understand her. 'Wait, Pip,' he said. 'Please speak slowly. I want to help you.'
slides.speaker_notes: Oliver tries to understand Pip, who is speaking too quickly because she is upset.

slides.title: Listening to Clues
slides.text: Pip took a deep breath. 'I lost my shiny pebble,' she said slowly. 'It’s my favourite one. I found it yesterday. I was playing near the big pink flowers. Then I flew to the tall green grass. Now it is gone!' A tear rolled down Pip's tiny cheek. Oliver listened carefully.
slides.speaker_notes: Pip explains what happened, giving Oliver clues about where she lost her pebble.

slides.title: Searching Together
slides.text: Oliver thought for a moment. 'You played near the big pink flowers first,' he said. 'Then you went to the tall green grass.' Pip nodded. 'Yes, that’s right!' Oliver looked closely at the ground. He walked slowly. His clever amber eyes looked for something shiny. 'Let's solve it together!' he said.
slides.speaker_notes: Oliver uses Pip's clues to start searching for the pebble, encouraging Pip.

slides.title: A Happy Find
slides.text: Near the big pink flowers, Oliver saw a sparkle! 'Look, Pip!' he said. It was Pip's shiny pebble! It was hiding under a small leaf. Pip flew down fast. She picked up her pebble with her beak. 'Thank you, Oliver!' she chirped. 'You listened to me very well!' Oliver smiled. He was happy to help his friend.
slides.speaker_notes: Oliver finds the pebble by listening carefully, making Pip very happy.
